runs.verdict: serialized: concurrent MergeWork matches the sequential baseline while the same transaction body without pg_advisory_xact_lock(731452) scales; the global advisory identity lock is the serializer
parallel: sharded identity locks let concurrent disjoint MergeWork scale past the sequential baseline, and the unlocked control confirms the write body itself was never the limit

runs.policy_observed: queued/running records are not lost and not re-run; restore re-labels them failed('scan interrupted by server restart'). Terminal records keep their state; succeeded keep their report.
runs.notes: catalog progress committed before the kill is durable (per-file merge transactions); unprocessed files of an interrupted scan are lost from the job but rescanning the source reproduces them without duplicating rows (idempotent content-keyed ids).
